nodes.name: dim_date
nodes.grain: 1 row per calendar day (2020-2027) + sentinel keys (-1, -2, -3)

nodes.name: vw_monthly_kpi
nodes.description: Monthly revenue, COGS, gross margin %, AOV, discounts, and Vietnamese Tet/Year-End seasonality.

nodes.name: vw_channel_performance
nodes.description: Omnichannel comparison across 6 physical stores, Web, and App including missing online ship-date tracking.

nodes.name: vw_return_metrics
nodes.description: Order-cohort return value and clean operational lead time excluding 4 flagged temporal anomalies.

nodes.name: vw_product_margin_history
nodes.description: Point-in-time SCD Type 2 SKU margin attribution across 71 historical price/cost versions.

nodes.name: vw_dq_executive_summary
nodes.description: Executive roll-up of automated CRITICAL/WARNING DQ gate results and PDPL compliance status.

nodes.name: mart_market_basket_rules
nodes.description: Product affinity & co-purchase association rules (support, confidence, lift) for cross-sell bundles.

nodes.name: mart_rfm_kmeans_clusters
nodes.description: Unsupervised K-Means++ clustering in log1p + Z-score RFM space vs. rule-based NTILE(5) segments (pseudonymized).

nodes.name: mart_return_risk_scores
nodes.description: Leakage-free out-of-time 2023->2024 post-fulfillment return-risk propensity scoring (L2 class-weighted logistic regression, order-time features only; mart.fact_returns is explicitly excluded as a feature and used strictly for timestamp-only point-in-time returned_at label & prior-return observability gating).

nodes.name: Page 1: Business Performance Dashboard
nodes.description: Executive revenue, gross profit, margin %, Tet/Year-End seasonality, and omnichannel mix.

nodes.name: Page 2: Product Performance Dashboard
nodes.description: Category/brand profitability, SCD2 price-change margin waterfall, and basket cross-sell insights.

nodes.name: Page 3: RFM Customer Segmentation Dashboard
nodes.description: Multi-snapshot RFM segment distribution, At-Risk win-back pool, and unsupervised K-Means++ customer clusters.

nodes.name: Page 4: Order Operations & Data Quality Dashboard
nodes.description: Fulfillment ship-date SLA, return lead-time monitoring, temporal anomaly quarantine, DQ gate health, and leakage-free return-risk scoring.
